question: Can ideal visible sphere/cylinder silhouette tangencies generate metric depth for the complete accepted four-camera E0 target, without point correspondences, known object sizes or input depth?
mechanism: Back-project oriented silhouette tangent lines into planes; solve unknown sphere centre/radius or vertical-cylinder XY centre/radius jointly from multiple calibrated camera centres. Infer cylinder cap heights from visible rim image rays and reconstructed radius. No point-patch matching, positive-cone voxel voting or fitting an existing metric point cloud.
novelty_evidence: Old causal multi-view plane sweep estimates per-pixel depth from ZNCC patches.
Old positive-cone memory retains possible voxels with positive mask support, without a tangent-surface equality.
Old qualified-seed shape identifiability fits an already measured 3D point cloud. This candidate instead generates metric shape/depth from 2D tangent planes.
scope: Necessary ideal-annotation qualification, not RGB inference. Ideal primitive-family, instance association, oriented silhouette tangents, rim identity and target semantic masks are privileged offline labels. Predictor receives no object centres/radii/heights or pixel depth. Sphere/vertical-cylinder family is an explicit restricted scene prior, not arbitrary obstacle geometry. All 300 objects and all original targets including suspended/unidentified remain in evaluation. Dataset is already seen development.
controls: All original frame targets reused unchanged; no target shrinkage. Ideal annotations are identical across pose arms. GT annotations never enter real navigation. No free-space or risk clearing. Frame t uses only exposures <=t from the last10s.

budget.note: Analytic least-squares geometry solves are performed; ML fit0 does not mean no geometric parameter estimation.

stop: Complete all110 frames and assess original gates. Failure closes this contour mechanism before RGB detector training/model acquisition/navigation; no tolerance/sampling/shape-family sweep. Passing admits only this privileged necessary geometric consumer, requiring a separately frozen actual RGB contour source and independent data qualification.
